description: This Java source file implements a service class 'PortfolioAccountReadPlatformServiceImpl' which provides methods to retrieve portfolio account data (savings and loan accounts) from a database using JDBC. It contains multiple inner classes for mapping result set rows to data objects and handles complex SQL queries for account retrieval, including refund-related queries.

classes.name: PortfolioSavingsAccountMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set rows into PortfolioAccountData objects for savings accounts.

classes.name: PortfolioLoanAccountMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set rows into PortfolioAccountData objects for loan accounts.

classes.name: PortfolioLoanAccountRefundByTransferMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map result rows for refund transfer accounts, including complex SQL schema and mapping logic.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single portfolio account data by account ID and type, optionally filtered by currency code.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of account data based on DTO parameters, filtering by account type, client ID, group ID, currency code, deposit type, and account status.

methods.name: retrieveOneByPaidInAdvance
methods.description: Retrieves account data related to paid-in-advance refunds by account ID and type.
